data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Azalea means 'help from God' or 'God's grace'. In Greek, it is derived from the word azelea, which means 'dry'. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the strength and protection of God. The name Azelea carries the meaning “God's help, God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Azelea usually hope their child will grow to embody god's help, god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
